name: Greedy Meshing (Back Face)
definition: A greedy meshing algorithm that generates quads for the back-facing surfaces (negative Z direction) of a voxel chunk. It merges adjacent blocks of the same type into larger rectangles.
summary: Greedy Meshing (Back Face) generates quads for the negative Z surfaces of voxel chunks by merging adjacent blocks into rectangles, distinctively operating exclusively on the back-facing boundary.
